## Today's learning {#iv2-objective .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

### Learning objective

Represent and calculate with vectors using components in two and three dimensions.

### Success criterion

I can convert between vector forms and calculate scalar multiples, sums and differences in 2D and 3D.

::: takeaway
Components let us calculate with the geometric vectors we already know.
:::

::: notes
Geometry and algebra remain connected throughout. Formal position vectors and vectors between given points are reserved for Lesson 3. Only standard unit vectors are needed here; calculating a unit vector in an arbitrary direction belongs to Lesson 4.
:::
